# Dubai Oil Shop

> Nước hoa dầu Dubai 10 ml. Đặt qua Zalo, nhận hàng COD tại Việt Nam.

Dubai Oil Shop is a Vietnamese-language shop for 10 ml Dubai oil perfumes. Orders, current prices, and stock availability are confirmed directly through Zalo.

## Main page

- [Dubai Oil Shop](https://dubaioilshop.com/): Shop overview, current scent collection, ordering information, and frequently asked questions.

## Ordering and contact

- [Order or ask via Zalo](https://zalo.me/84966987156): Confirm the current scent availability, price, and delivery address before placing an order.
- [Call Dubai Oil Shop](tel:+84966987156): +84 966 987 156.

## Product information

- Bottle size: 10 ml.
- Delivery: From Vietnam; cash on delivery (COD) is available.
- Current scents named on the website: Chanel Coco, Chanel Nancy, Good Girl, Baccarat Rouge 540, and Gucci Flora.
- Prices and availability vary by scent and incoming stock. Contact the shop for the current details.

## Brand-name note

Scent names are used to identify products. Dubai Oil Shop does not use logos or claim affiliation with trademark owners.
